mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, shipment_number, inbound_id, id, basic_class, purchase_type, invoice_type, serial_number, inbound_SN, purchase_SN, license_plate,logistics_transport_type,logistics_payer_type, project_ids, loading_weight, tax_rate, freight, amount_excluding_VAT, input_VAT, remark, supplier_id, supplier_name, applicant_id, applicant_name, user_update_time
mapper.select:
select slo.id, slo.basic_class, slo.purchase_type, slo.invoice_type, slo.serial_number, slo.shipment_number, slo.license_plate, slo.logistics_transport_type, slo.logistics_payer_type, slo.project_ids, slo.loading_weight, slo.tax_rate, slo.freight, slo.amount_excluding_VAT, slo.input_VAT, slo.remark, slo.supplier_id, lo_sup.name as supplier_name, slo.applicant_id, slo.applicant_name, slo.user_update_time, slo.create_time, slo.inbound_review_status, slo.inbound_id 'inboundReceipt.id', slo.inbound_sn 'inboundReceipt.serial_number', slo.purchase_id 'purchaseOrder.id', slo.purchase_sn 'purchaseOrder.serial_number' from scm_logistics_order slo LEFT JOIN scm_supplier lo_sup on slo.supplier_id = lo_sup.id and lo_sup.bool_delete_enum = 0 where slo.bool_delete_enum = 0 and slo.inbound_review_status = 2
and slo.purchase_type = #{purchaseType}
and slo.project_ids is null
and slo.project_ids IS NOT NULL
and find_in_set(#{projectId}, slo.project_ids)
and slo.shipment_number like CONCAT('%', #{shipmentNumber},'%')
and slo.serial_number like CONCAT('%', #{serialNumber},'%')
and slo.logistics_transport_type = #{logisticsTransportType}
and date(slo.create_time) >= date(#{createTime[0]})
and date(slo.create_time) <= date(#{createTime[1]})
and slo.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
and slo.applicant_name like CONCAT('%', #{operatorName},'%')
and slo.purchase_SN like CONCAT('%', #{purchaseSN},'%')
and slo.inbound_SN like CONCAT('%', #{inboundSN},'%')
and slo.license_plate like CONCAT('%', #{licensePlate},'%')
ORDER BY slo.id desc
select COUNT(*) from scm_logistics_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m')

SELECT temp.supplier_id, temp.supplier_name, temp.branch_company_id, temp.branch_company_name, temp.freight, temp.create_time FROM ( SELECT ss.id AS supplier_id, ss.`name` AS supplier_name, p.contract_sign_body_id AS branch_company_id, bc.`name` AS branch_company_name, c.total_price AS freight, c.create_time FROM mes_building_cargo_list AS c INNER JOIN mes_building_supplier_price AS sp ON sp.id = c.supplier_price_id AND sp.bool_delete_enum = 0 and sp.bool_personal_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project AS p ON p.id = c.project_id AND p.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN scm_supplier AS ss ON sp.supplier_id = ss.id AND ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN sys_branch_company AS bc ON p.contract_sign_body_id = bc.id AND bc.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE c.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND c.status IN (4, 8)
AND ss.name LIKE concat('%',#{supplierName},'%')
UNION ALL
SELECT slo.supplier_id, ss.`name` AS supplier_name, spo.branch_company_id, bc.`name` AS branch_company_name, slo.freight, slo.create_time FROM scm_logistics_order AS slo LEFT JOIN scm_purchase_order AS spo ON slo.purchase_id = spo.id AND spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_branch_company AS bc ON spo.branch_company_id = bc.id AND bc.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN scm_supplier AS ss ON slo.supplier_id = ss.id AND ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE slo.inbound_review_status = 2
AND ss.name LIKE concat('%',#{supplierName},'%')
) AS temp

SELECT slo.id id, wi.review_time inboundPassTime, slo.license_plate licensePlate, slo.loading_charge loadingCharge, wi.id inboundId, wi.serial_number inboundSN, slo.loading_weight loadingWeight, slo.freight_weight freightWeight, spo.id purchaseOrderId, spo.serial_number purchaseOrderSN, spo.applicant_name purchaseUserName, wi.applicant_name inboundUserName FROM scm_logistics_order slo LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi on wi.id = slo.inbound_id and wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN scm_purchase_order spo on spo.id = wi.purchase_id and spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE slo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wi.review_status = 2 AND slo.loading_charge IS NOT NULL
AND wi.review_time >= #{passStartDate}
AND wi.review_time <= #{passEndDate}
AND slo.license_plate LIKE concat('%',#{licensePlate},'%')
AND wi.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{inboundSN},'%')
AND spo.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{purchaseOrderSN},'%')
AND ( spo.applicant_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%') OR wi.applicant_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%') )

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(slo.loading_charge),0) loadingChargeSum FROM scm_logistics_order slo LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi on wi.id = slo.inbound_id and wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN scm_purchase_order spo on spo.id = wi.purchase_id and spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE slo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wi.review_status = 2
AND wi.review_time >= #{passStartDate}
AND wi.review_time <= #{passEndDate}
AND slo.license_plate LIKE concat('%',#{licensePlate},'%')
AND wi.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{inboundSN},'%')
AND spo.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{purchaseOrderSN},'%')
AND ( spo.applicant_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%') OR wi.applicant_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%') )
